name: WHITE DWARF
generated: Drafted from WHITE DWARF (single-file groovebox) by tools/map-from-html.js; edit freely
rules: Every setting is a byte bound to the instrument's own control. Writing the byte moves the control; moving the control rewrites the byte.
A byte has 256 steps: the control's range is spread across them, on a log curve for wide frequency ranges.
Capabilities are declared in CAPS like any REGISTER machine.
